# E² Core Framework

> Public navigation index for the E² Core Framework. ORMD is the AI-facing authority; Semantic Substrate Markdown is the human reading surface.

## How to read this corpus

1. Start with the Context Layer Master Index.
2. Select the relevant A–K cluster and read only the ORMD documents needed for the task.
3. Preserve each document's frame, confidence, lineage, and policy metadata.
4. Do not treat the index, generated catalog, or human Markdown as a substitute for the paired ORMD authority.

- [Context Layer Master Index (ORMD)](/ormd/context-layer-master-index.ormd)
- [Machine-readable catalog](/catalog.json)
- [Combined ORMD corpus](/ormd-corpus.txt)
- [Human mobile reader](/)

## Cluster A — Foundational Axioms & Core Ontology

Scope: The irreducible bedrock of E². Establishes what relationships *are*, how they compose, and what constraints govern all relational systems. Every other cluster presupposes this one.

Entry point: Relational Primitives → E^2 Equation → Global Closure Operator

- [E^2 Axioms](/ormd/e2-axioms.ormd) — frame: philosophy.relational-ontology.axioms; confidence: 0.92
- [E^2 Entry Point](/ormd/e2-entry-point.ormd) — frame: ontology.relational.e2; confidence: 0.92
- [E^2 Equation: Recursive Composition and the Global Closure Operator](/ormd/e2-equation.ormd) — frame: ontology.relational-physics; confidence: 0.98
- [Global Closure Operator](/ormd/global-closure-operator.ormd) — frame: theoretical.ontology.relational; confidence: 0.95

- [Relational Primitives](/ormd/relational-primitives.ormd) — frame: formal.ontology.relational; confidence: 0.96

## Cluster G — Consciousness, Cognition & Identity

Scope: How relational dynamics give rise to consciousness, cognitive structure, and identity. Treats consciousness as triadic relational architecture, intelligence as field navigation, and cognition as collective substrate. Distinct from [F](#cluster-f "symmetric:constrains") (which addresses threats to cognitive integrity) and from [H](#cluster-h "dynamical:produces") (which applies these to social systems).

Entry point: Relational Emergence Meta-Architecture (REMA) → Collective Cognitive Substrate → Relational Volition

- [Collective Cognitive Substrate](/ormd/collective-cognitive-substrate.ormd) — frame: cognitive.ecology.synthesis; confidence: 0.9

- [Relational Emergence Meta-Architecture (REMA)](/ormd/relational-emergence-meta-architecture-rema.ormd) — frame: theory.consciousness.rema; confidence: 0.88
- [Relational Volition: A Synthesis on the Nature of Freedom within Relational Fields](/ormd/relational-volition.ormd) — frame: philosophy.relational-physics; confidence: 0.9
- [The 'Intelligence Field' Framework](/ormd/the-intelligence-field-framework.ormd) — frame: cognitive.theory.framework; confidence: 0.85

## Cluster I — Protocol, Infrastructure & Meta

Scope: The operational layer — how the Context Layer itself is structured, transmitted, and versioned. CLP defines the data model governing all other clusters; RPE is the simulation engine for relational primitives; Implementations is the living registry of E² applications.

Entry point: Context Layer Protocol (CLP) → Implementations → Relational Primitive Engine (RPE)

- [Context Layer Protocol (CLP) — Overview & Starter Spec v0.2](/ormd/context-layer-protocol-clp.ormd) — frame: protocol.specification; confidence: 0.9
- [Implementations](/ormd/implementations.ormd) — frame: registry.implementations; confidence: 1
- [Relational Primitive Engine (RPE)](/ormd/relational-primitive-engine-rpe.ormd) — frame: engineering.simulation.rpe; confidence: 0.98

## Cluster J — Semantic Substrate (Working/Provisional)

Scope: Low-level working documents generated from or supporting the semantic substrate derivation layer. These are provisional formalizations — stubs, synthesis notes, and flow mappings — rather than settled theory. Treat as reference material, not canonical sources.

Entry point: No single entry point; consult as reference material when working with formal derivations in A or B.

- [Boundary Dynamics](/ormd/boundary-dynamics.ormd) — frame: e2.semantic_substrate; confidence: 0.9
